about: [O7 after the critic, B4] the phone box's car and the one I came in: both enterable; E at the old one: in it, it is my car.

steps.eval: (() => { const B = G.night.phone.setup(); const e = G.eye; const b = B.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.hypot(a.x - e.x, a.z - e.z) - Math.hypot(c.x - e.x, c.z - e.z))[0]; window.__box = b; const nx = Math.sin(b.yaw || 0), nz = Math.cos(b.yaw || 0); let px = b.x + 1.2, pz = b.z; for (const [dx, dz] of [[1.2, 0], [-1.2, 0], [0, 1.2], [0, -1.2]]) { const q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + dx, 0, b.z + dz); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.3); if (Math.hypot(q.x - b.x - dx, q.z - b.z - dz) < 0.05) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.1); void nx; void nz; return [b.x, b.z]; })()

steps.label: the phone's car at the kerb
the phone's car is my car

steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__old; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(c.pos.x, c.pos.z); N.controller.setPose(c.pos.x + Math.sin(c.yaw) * 2.4, c.pos.z + Math.cos(c.yaw) * 2.4, Math.atan2(Math.sin(c.yaw), Math.cos(c.yaw)), -0.1); return 1; })()
